info.name: Pipedrive API v1 Activities Pipelines API
Get deals conversion rates in pipeline

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the pipeline

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start of the period. Date in format of YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end of the period. Date in format of YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: user_id
params.description: The ID of the user who's pipeline metrics statistics to fetch. If omitted, the authorized user will be used.

items.docs: Returns all stage-to-stage conversion and pipeline-to-close rates for the given time period.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the pipeline

params.name: filter_id
params.description: If supplied, only deals matching the given filter will be returned

params.name: user_id
params.description: If supplied, `filter_id` will not be considered and only deals owned by the given user will be returned. If omitted, deals owned by the authorized user will be returned.

params.name: everyone
params.description: If supplied, `filter_id` and `user_id` will not be considered – instead, deals owned by everyone will be returned

params.name: stage_id
params.description: If supplied, only deals within the given stage will be returned

params.name: start
params.description: Pagination start

params.name: limit
params.description: Items shown per page

params.name: get_summary
params.description: Whether to include a summary of the pipeline in the `additional_data` or not

params.name: totals_convert_currency
params.description: The 3-letter currency code of any of the supported currencies. When supplied, `per_stages_converted` is returned inside `deals_summary` inside `additional_data` which contains the currency-converted total amounts in the given currency per each stage. You may also set this parameter to `default_currency` in which case users default currency is used. Only works when `get_summary` parameter flag is enabled.

items.docs:
Lists deals in a specific pipeline across all its stages. If no parameters are provided open deals owned by the authorized user will be returned.
This endpoint has been deprecated. Please use GET /api/v2/deals?pipeline_id={id} instead.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The field to sort by. Supported fields: `id`, `update_time`, `add_time`.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: The sorting direction. Supported values: `asc`, `desc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: For pagination, the limit of entries to be returned. If not provided, 100 items will be returned. Please note that a maximum value of 500 is allowed.

params.name: cursor
params.description: For pagination, the marker (an opaque string value) representing the first item on the next page
